project.name: Project-2-Battleship
project.summary: Two people share a terminal Battleship game: place ships privately, alternate shots and end when one fleet is removed. State is held in Python objects; no HTTP routes.

nodes.label: Turn coordinator
nodes.summary: Game constructs both players, stages private placement and alternates attacks.

nodes.label: Players and shot memory
nodes.summary: Each Player prompts for a name, creates a Board and remembers attempted shots.

nodes.label: Board and targeting
nodes.summary: Board owns the grid, placement prompts, coordinate checks, hit markers and victory exit.

nodes.label: Fleet damage state
nodes.summary: Ship stores size, coordinates and remaining hit points; sunk checks for depletion.

edges.label: Prompt each player and build their board.
Place each ship, then hide visible ship markers before handoff.
Reduce hit points for a coordinate hit and remove sunk ships.
Mark hit or miss and exit if the opponent has no ships.
